'''Sea-leaves''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. Sea-leaves could be used to make tarps, and were also used to wrap the dead in.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
